mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market weakness that triggers central bank policy support, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in employment (PAYEMS) indicates weak consumer spending despite job growth, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: The joint signal of RSAFS decline and PAYEMS rise fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-2008 recovery periods, a stable federal funds rate (within 0.05% of prior month) signals sustained accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during post-2008 recovery when FEDFUNDS is stable, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past three months indicates robust manufacturing activity that typically leads to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic slowdown expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 600.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in unemployment rate signals central bank response to labor market deterioration, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic weakness expectations rise.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to labor deterioration
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS decline and UNRATE increase fails to predict negative returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), a decline in unemployment exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals improving labor market conditions that typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE declines by >0.1pp in high unemployment regimes, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
